Inspect our working software increment with stakeholders and adapt our product backlog.
Write a unit test with Jest for an email validator.
Configure an OAuth 2.1 authorization server in Go.

binary_cases.prompt: Generate a Sprint Review Increment Audit for an e-commerce subscription squad demonstrating a new customer portal.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must include Sprint Goal evaluation, Definition of Done audit with binary verdicts, live demo findings, and explicit Product Backlog adaptation items.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## 1. Sprint Goal Evaluation
- **Sprint Goal**: 'Enable subscribers to pause, skip, or swap subscription items self-serve from their account dashboard.'
- **Verdict**: **ACHIEVED** (All 3 self-serve controls functional in staging demo).

## 2. Definition of Done (DoD) Audit
- [x] Unit test coverage $\ge 85\%$ (Current: 89.2%).
- [x] Staging E2E smoke tests passing (100% green).
- [x] WCAG AA accessibility audit verified (Keyboard navigable, screen reader labels confirmed).
- [x] Zero high-severity security vulnerabilities in dependencies.
- [x] API documentation updated in OpenAPI spec.

## 3. Working Increment Demo Findings
- *Feature 1 (Skip Delivery)*: Flawless demo; skipped next box and updated next billing date in real-time.
- *Feature 2 (Product Swap)*: Demonstrated item swap; stakeholder noted that modal search could use category filter chips.
- *Feature 3 (Pause Subscription)*: Clean 30/60/90 day pause options.

## 4. Product Backlog Adaptation
- **Added to Next Sprint**: Category filter chips on product swap modal (Estimated: 3 pts).
- **Deprioritized**: Cancel flow questionnaire moved to Sprint 20 backlog.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: We showed the app to stakeholders and they gave us thumbs up. We will ship it next week.
